global_caption: In a desolate dystopian mega-city skyline, two separated companions find one another across a series of high-altitude sky-bridges at daybreak. The sequence follows the subject approaching the meeting point, the second subject waiting at a terminal, and finally the subject reacting with emotional relief upon spotting their friend, all framed to highlight their front-facing expressions against a dramatic chiaroscuro dawn. The main subject descriptions and shared visual context are: a weary scavenger, with a metallic prosthetic arm and a dirt-streaked canvas duster; the second subject, a tech-exile, with glowing optic implants and a frayed hood over a tactical vest. The video plays at normal speed.

The camera tracks backward on the narrow sky-bridge in a medium-full shot as the scavenger approaches.
